cards.back:
Strong and well, not ill.
Bahasa Indonesia: sehat
Example: Fruit keeps you healthy.
cards.say: healthy. Fruit keeps you healthy.

cards.back:
Not well in your body.
Bahasa Indonesia: sakit
Example: My brother is ill today.
cards.say: ill. My brother is ill today.

cards.back:
When your body is too hot because you are ill.
Bahasa Indonesia: demam
Example: I have a fever and stay in bed.
cards.say: fever. I have a fever and stay in bed.

cards.back:
To push air out of your throat with a noise.
Bahasa Indonesia: batuk
Example: I cough when I have a cold.
cards.say: cough. I cough when I have a cold.

cards.back:
A small illness where your nose is wet and you sneeze.
Bahasa Indonesia: pilek
Example: I have a cold and a runny nose.
cards.say: cold. I have a cold and a runny nose.

cards.back:
A pain in your head.
Bahasa Indonesia: sakit kepala
Example: I have a headache after the noise.
cards.say: headache. I have a headache after the noise.

cards.back:
A pain in your tummy.
Bahasa Indonesia: sakit perut
Example: I have a stomach ache.
cards.say: stomach ache. I have a stomach ache.

cards.back:
A pain in your tooth.
Bahasa Indonesia: sakit gigi
Example: Sweets can give you toothache.
cards.say: toothache. Sweets can give you toothache.

cards.back:
A throat that hurts when you swallow.
Bahasa Indonesia: sakit tenggorokan
Example: I have a sore throat today.
cards.say: sore throat. I have a sore throat today.

cards.back:
To stop work and relax your body.
Bahasa Indonesia: beristirahat
Example: You must rest when you are ill.
cards.say: rest. You must rest when you are ill.

cards.back:
Moving your body to keep strong.
Bahasa Indonesia: berolahraga
Example: Exercise is good for your heart.
cards.say: exercise. Exercise is good for your heart.

cards.back:
Something you take to get better when you are ill.
Bahasa Indonesia: obat
Example: I take medicine after dinner.
cards.say: medicine. I take medicine after dinner.

cards.back:
A long strip of cloth to cover a cut.
Bahasa Indonesia: perban
Example: The nurse puts a bandage on my knee.
cards.say: bandage. The nurse puts a bandage on my knee.

cards.back:
A small wound on the skin.
Bahasa Indonesia: luka sayat
Example: I have a cut on my finger.
cards.say: cut. I have a cut on my finger.

cards.back:
A hard white part inside your body.
Bahasa Indonesia: tulang
Example: Milk makes your bones strong.
cards.say: bone. Milk makes your bones strong.

cards.back:
A part of your body that helps you move.
Bahasa Indonesia: otot
Example: Swimming makes your muscles strong.
cards.say: muscle. Swimming makes your muscles strong.

cards.back:
The part inside your chest that pumps blood.
Bahasa Indonesia: jantung
Example: My heart beats fast when I run.
cards.say: heart. My heart beats fast when I run.

cards.back:
The red liquid that moves inside your body.
Bahasa Indonesia: darah
Example: Blood moves round your body.
cards.say: blood. Blood moves round your body.

cards.back:
The outside covering of your body.
Bahasa Indonesia: kulit
Example: Wash your skin with soap.
cards.say: skin. Wash your skin with soap.

cards.back:
To clean your hands with soap and water.
Bahasa Indonesia: cuci tangan
Example: Wash your hands before you eat.
cards.say: wash your hands. Wash your hands before you eat.

cards.back:
To blow air out of your nose suddenly.
Bahasa Indonesia: bersin
Example: I sneeze when I smell dust.
cards.say: sneeze. I sneeze when I smell dust.

cards.back:
Free from dirt.
Bahasa Indonesia: bersih
Example: Keep your nails clean.
cards.say: clean. Keep your nails clean.

cards.back:
To rest with your eyes closed.
Bahasa Indonesia: tidur
Example: You need to sleep for ten hours.
cards.say: sleep. You need to sleep for ten hours.
